summary: Ambev S.A. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 12, 2026, reporting the final analytical consolidated voting map for its Ordinary and Extraordinary General Shareholders Meetings held on April 30, 2026. The filing covers standard agenda items such as approval of management accounts, financial statements for fiscal year 2025, and other ordinary resolutions. This is a routine disclosure required of foreign private issuers, not a special situation event, as it merely summarizes shareholder votes without any transactional or transformative action.
